offering_description.value: Lindsay makes mechanized irrigation systems and sells remote monitoring and control software to farms. It also makes highway barriers, barrier transfer machines and crash protection equipment for transportation agencies and contractors, and leases road safety equipment for construction projects.

primary_products.value: center-pivot and lateral-move irrigation systems; irrigation controls and software; movable and specialty road barriers; barrier transfer machines; crash cushions and guardrail end terminals

primary_services.value: road safety equipment leasing; remote irrigation monitoring, control and scheduling

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial growers, farm operators, irrigation dealers and highway contractors; B2G: transportation departments and other public road authorities

end_markets.value: irrigated agriculture; highway construction and maintenance; road safety and traffic management

revenue_model.value: product sales: irrigation systems and controls, highway barriers, transfer machines and crash protection equipment; subscription: remote irrigation monitoring, control and scheduling software; rental or leasing: road barriers and transfer machines for highway construction projects
revenue_model.category: product sales; subscription; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: turns steel and purchased components into irrigation and road safety equipment for growers, contractors and road agencies; software / platform: uses field and equipment data to provide growers with irrigation monitoring, scheduling and control tools; service provider: supplies temporary barrier systems and transfer machines to highway contractors and road agencies
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North and South America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: diversified: mechanized farm irrigation and irrigation software, plus highway barriers and crash protection equipment

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent irrigation dealers and road safety equipment distributors; direct sales: highway contractors and public transportation agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: highway hardware crash-testing requirements under AASHTO standards and environmental and workplace safety rules for manufacturing

notes: The current scope of smaller contract manufacturing activities is uncertain.
